description: The Occupation lens: for each occupation, the national VET qualifications published to Europass that lead to it (matched by title), by country and EQF level, with Cedefop's employment forecast for its occupation group.
method: Each occupation has 'include' and 'exclude' regular expressions, applied to the qualification's title and original-language title after lower-casing and removing accents. Patterns cover the national languages of the 14 countries that publish VET qualifications to Europass, and were checked by hand against every match on 18 October 2026. Matching by title finds most qualifications for an occupation but not all: titles that name only a field ('Electrical engineering') or a level are missed unless listed.
